rows.en: By devouring prey again and again, Bogal evolves into Bogal Monst!!
In power, in abilities, in every respect, it far surpasses Bogal!!
Your luck runs out here!! Do it!! Do it now!! Bogal Monst!!
...Curses!! Not again!! Bogal Monst, can you move!? We fall back for now!!
Gukiiiiiii...
...Hm? What is it?
Bogal Monst began writhing in agony. Energy was erupting from all over its body!
What!! ...Has it devoured so much that the energy is condensing inside its body!!
This is bad... It's going to cause a massive explosion...!!
What!?
Don't come this way! Bogal Monst! The heroes are your enemy!
Fufufu... Heroes! Get caught in Bogal Monst's explosion and die!! Farewell!!
Bogal Monst turned around and charged at {8074} and the others!
Get down!!
Hey! You still alive!?

notes.note: Garagaranda (Ambassador Hell's true form) boasting about Bogal Monst; #0.60 (battle) not in table. #0.61 is his post-battle line; 'Curses!!' for the archaic villain's 'kuso'.
Bogal Monst weak cry (guki-i...); coined 'Gukiiiiiii...', distinct from its battle roar in story_100 #0.40.
Source is a rhetorical question ending in double exclamation; kept as a question shape with '!!'.
Garagaranda to Bogal Monst, which is heading toward him; then it turns on the heroes (#0.70).
Unlabelled silence after the explosion (script: no name window).

#0.75-89 leader block. Pt_Chara_Check order 5,1,14,15,4,6,7,3,10,9,2,11,12,8,13 = OOO, Rider 1, Mebius, Zero, W, Nu, Zeta, Momotaros, 00, Wing Zero, RX, Ultraman, Seven, God Gundam, Taro (decompiler shows 8 twice in the 13th slot; 12 assumed). Wording fits: #0.77 polite Mebius, #0.78 cocky Zero, #0.82 Momotaros, #0.84 Heero's self-destruct joke.
Item name rendered 'Key Ring' to match 'ring of keys' from the Dada scene (story_100).
Ankh realizing Bogal swallowed Dada, who held the key ring; 'key ring and all' carries the 'Dada holding the key ring' detail.

#0.3-17 leader block. Order 5,1,14,15,4,6,7,3,10,9,2,11,12,8,13 = OOO, Rider 1, Mebius, Zero, W, Nu, Zeta, Momotaros, 00, Wing Zero, RX, Ultraman, Seven, God Gundam, Taro. W's slot (#0.7) shows Philip's name window per script; 'I see' analytical tone fits.

#0.2-15 leader block. Order 4,5,1,2,3,15,14,13,12,11,6,7,8,10,9 = W, OOO, Rider 1, RX, Momotaros, Zero, Mebius, Taro, Seven, Ultraman, Nu, Zeta, God Gundam, 00 (Wing Zero's slot #0.16 has no row). #0.2 W says 'my'; #0.6 Momotaros; #0.8 polite Mebius.

#0.4-16 leader block (#0.17-18 in story_102). Order 4,5,1,2,3,15,14,13,12,11,6,7,8,10,9 = W, OOO, Rider 1, RX, Momotaros, Zero, Mebius, Taro, Seven, Ultraman, Nu, Zeta, God Gundam, 00, Wing Zero. 'Without being told, I'll beat you' -> 'You don't have to tell me! I'll take you down!' Subject 'I' restored.

Mebius's line deliberately trails off after 'even without being told'; rendered as a complete short retort with 'us' (Mebius speaks for the team), the implied 'we'll beat you' left unsaid as in the source.

report: 80/80 rows translated. Leader blocks ordered from each script's Pt_Chara_Check chain (0568 #0.75-89, 0569 #0.3-17, 0570 #0.2-15, 0571 #0.4-16). Uncertain: 0568 13th slot shows check 8 twice (assumed Seven; text identical anyway); 0571 #0.10 Mebius trailing-off line rendered as complete retort. Coined: Bogal Monst weak cry 'Gukiiiiiii...'; item 'Key Ring'. No new names.
